court: In the High Court of Madras
appellants: B.S. Pictures, rep by its Proprietor Balasundaram … Appellant(s);
advocates: For Respondent(s): M/s. V. Srimathi (For R 1)
prayer: Prayer: appeal Suit filed under Section 96 of the Code of Civil Procedure, praying to set aside the judgment and decree of the The learned VII Additional Judge, City Civil Court, Madras, passed in O.S. No. 8809 of 2010 dated 6-11-2013.
judgment_text:
The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

K. Kumaresh Babu, J.:— When the matter was taken up for hearing on 10-3-2026, there was no representation on the side of the appellant, either in person or through the learned counsel. Hence, this Court directed the matter to be listed on 17-3-2026.

2. Again, when the matter was taken up for hearing on 17-3-2026, there was no representation on the side of the appellant. In order to grant one more opportunity, this Court directed the Registry to list the matter on 23-3-2026 (today) under the caption “For Dismissal”.

3. Even today, when the matter was taken up, there is no representation on the side of the appellant. Hence, it is evident that the appellant is not interested in prosecuting the appeal. Accordingly, this appeal suit stands dismissed for non-prosecution. No costs.
